primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'t': 'decision timestamp (seconds since epoch)', 'observed_at': 'timestamp of data ingestion (seconds since epoch)'}

primitives.assumptions: Model must report sufficient predictions to validate calibration; gate flips only after 3 consecutive green reports.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Flipping gate on insufficient or spurious calibration metrics.

layer2.mapping: Founder gate enforces a conformal prediction kernel, where model reliability is validated via statistical calibration.
layer2.telemetry: Brier and ECE scores over rolling window of predictions.

primitives.name: Kill Ledger Append-Only
primitives.verbatim_quote: Kill ledger append-only | `KillLedger` | JSONL, hash-chained (`prev_sha→chain_sha`); **no delete/clear verb exists**; `verify_chain()` detects rewrite
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'prev_sha': 'SHA-256 hash of previous entry (bytes)', 'chain_sha': 'SHA-256 hash of current entry (bytes)'}
primitives.assumptions: Each entry is cryptographically chained; no deletion or modification allowed.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Tampering detected via SHA mismatch in `verify_chain()`.

layer2.telemetry: Hash chain verification upon each ledger update.
